title: E perchè fosti meco
subtitle: The Count, Susanna and Figaro: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3
note: The Count asks why Susanna was so cold that morning
about: Score: the recitative “E perchè fosti meco” (vocal score pages 214-215, 18 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
